found_bugs.title: Shipping → Package presets never load or save
found_bugs.detail: app/shipping.tsx calls api.packagePresets.list/create/update/remove → /api/package-presets. routes/index.ts imports packagePresetsRouter (line 153) but never calls router.use() with it, so every call 404s and the screen silently shows no presets.
found_bugs.fix: One line in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts: router.use("/package-presets", requireAuth, packagePresetsRouter) (check the auth middleware the file expects). Not done here: this PR changes no code.
